items.title: Registrations
items.description: Form a team of 2 to 5 and register. Open to students from every college and university.

items.title: Remote Elimination
items.description: Submit your team presentation and a video or demo. Shortlisted teams are invited to campus.

items.title: Hacking Begins
items.description: Check in, collect your welcome kit and start building. The 30-hour clock starts now.

items.title: Checkpoint 1
items.description: Problem understanding, solution design, early proof of work and your plan for the next 20 hours.

items.title: Checkpoint 2
items.description: Working components, technical execution, usability and how you handled blockers.

items.title: Final Judging & Awards
items.description: Demo your final prototype to the panel. Winners and special awards are announced.
